title: Interrupted live writes never duplicate records and retain Undo preimages
steps: Run the live writer against the fault-injecting HTTP engine fixture.
expect: Lost create responses and killed workers never resend an uncertain write.
Acknowledged creates survive read-back failure and restart with usable Undo evidence.
Identical create payloads retain distinct item identities; concurrent Apply processes share a lock.
Incomplete batch rollback stays uncertain; explicit writer-busy refusals remain retryable.

tests: lost create response is uncertain and Apply never creates it again or starts its dependents
a failed read-back preserves the create ACK and Undo evidence without another create
an ACK recovers its original preimage after a cut before the item journal
two Apply processes cannot mutate the same push concurrently
two distinct creates with identical fields retain distinct live IDs
a batch with incomplete rollback is never sent again after Apply restarts
a worker killed after create cannot resend that create when Apply restarts
